headline: Sensex Surges 898 Points, Nifty Reclaims 25,800 Powered by Banking Stocks and FPI Inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) inflows and a rally in the Indian Rupee supported market momentum.
Cooling crude oil prices helped boost overall market sentiment.
Banking stocks led the market rally with Nifty Bank scaling a new record high.
Support from IT stocks helped Indian equities recover and defy a weak global market environment.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 898 points while Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,800 mark after opening lower earlier in the day.
Nifty Bank scaled a new record high driven by buying interest in major banking counters.
US FDA issued a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification to Natco Pharma's FDF facility in Vizag.
SEBI floated a consultation paper reviewing additional disclosure norms for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs).
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp recovery, defying a weak global market trend as the Sensex jumped nearly 900 points to reclaim 25,800. Strong gains in banking and IT stocks, coupled with FPI inflows and cooling crude oil prices, fueled the rally. Nifty Bank hit a new record high during the trading session.
